notificationsDesc.zh: 窗口在后台时，提醒你处理会话请求或查看已结束的任务
notificationsDesc.en: When the window is in the background, get notified when a session needs input or a task ends

unsupported.zh: 当前页面无法使用系统通知。
unsupported.en: System notifications are unavailable on this page.

denied.zh: 通知权限已被阻止，请在此网站的权限设置中允许通知。
denied.en: Notifications are blocked. Allow notifications in this site's permissions.

default.zh: 开启时，请允许此网站发送通知。
default.en: Allow notifications for this site when you turn this on.

requestFailed.zh: 无法获取通知权限，请检查此网站的权限设置后重试。
requestFailed.en: Couldn't request notification permission. Check this site's permissions and try again.

permission.zh: 有会话需要你处理请求。
